reason: Python mode gains sympy: a subset of SymPy's interface (sympy.abc symbols, arithmetic with integer and float powers, diff, subs, Matrix with jacobian and subs, NumPy arrays, SymPy's printed and LaTeX forms) over the symbolic engine. lib/sympy is a package of its own: the CLI embeds it (cli/pyjs.cjs, cli/lib.gen.js), and the browser fetches it as its own lazy chunk on import, which the worker's and the notebook page's lists of chunks now name (engine/sagebrush-worker.js, engine/sagebrush-notebook.js).
